comment: Tier D: restricted / actively enforced (spec §3.3, §5.3). Concord describes these groups' teaching using Tier A/B secondary scholarly sources and NEVER ingests or quotes their primary literature. Additions to this list are a legal decision, not an engineering one. Review with counsel before changing.

entries.name: Jehovah's Witnesses (Watch Tower Bible and Tract Society publications)
entries.reason: Documented history of aggressive copyright enforcement against religious-studies use.

entries.name: Christian Science (Science and Health editions still under copyright)
entries.reason: Post-1929 editions under active copyright; early editions may be re-tiered after legal review.
entries.describe_via: Tier A/B scholarly sources; public-domain 1875 edition pending legal review
